sources.verbatim: function semanticOwnerErrors(o){const errors=[];for(const [name,p]of Object.entries(o.profiles)){const h=p.registrations.headers.processing;for(const [preset,rules]of Object.entries(h.presets)){if(new Set(rules.map(r=>r.id)).size!==rules.length)errors.push(`${name}/${preset}:duplicate-preset-id`);for(const r of rules)if(r.kind==='hsts-min-age'&&(!/^\d+$/.test(r.value)||!Number.isSafeInteger(Number(r.value))||Number(r.value)<1))errors.push(`${name}:invalid-finite-hsts`);}const base=h.presets[h.profile],add=h.rules.add,replace=h.rules.replace,remove=h.rules.remove;if(new Set(add.map(r=>r.id)).size!==add.length||new Set(replace.map(r=>r.id)).size!==replace.length||new Set(remove).size!==remove.length||add.some(r=>base.some(x=>x.id===r.id)||replace.some(x=>x.id===r.id))||replace.some(r=>!base.some(x=>x.id===r.id)))errors.push(`${name}:rule-composition-invalid`);const headerError=resolvedHeaderError(h);if(headerError)errors.push(`${name}:resolved-native-header-domain:${headerError}`);const count=base.filter(r=>!remove.includes(r.id)).length+add.length;if(count<1||count>64)errors.push(`${name}:resolved-rule-count`);for(const [reg,body]of Object.entries(p.registrations)){const waivers=body.processing.policy.acceptances;if(new Set(waivers.map(w=>w.findingId)).size!==waivers.length||waivers.some(w=>w.reason.trim().length<8||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(w.expiresAt))))errors.push(`${name}/${reg}:invalid-waiver`);if(body.declarations.matrixFields.length)errors.push(`${name}/${reg}:unread-or-unsupported-matrix`);if(Object.values(body.declarations.evidenceDefaults).some(types=>types.length!==1||types[0]!=='log'))errors.push(`${name}/${reg}:mandatory-log-missing`);if(h.requestTimeoutMs>assoc.network.maximumExecutionMs||h.maximumResponseBytes>assoc.network.maximumResponseBytes)errors.push(`${name}:native-network-mismatch`);}}return errors;}
